description: This file defines a React functional component 'CodeMirrorWrapper' used for rendering and managing a code editor interface with syntax highlighting, line highlights, error markers, and linkification. It integrates with the CodeMirror library and includes customization for different programming languages and modes. The component handles dynamic loading of the CodeMirror module, configuration updates, and user interactions such as clicking on links within the editor.

methods.name: onCodeMirrorClick
methods.description: Handles click events within the CodeMirror editor to open links in new tabs.

methods.name: defineCustomMode
methods.description: Defines a custom 'linkified' mode in CodeMirror for recognizing web links.

methods.name: mimeTypeToMode
methods.description: Maps MIME types to CodeMirror modes for syntax highlighting.

methods.name: highlighterToMode
methods.description: Converts a highlighter enum to a corresponding CodeMirror mode string.
